title: Bold Venture
identity_notes: Star-led Caribbean adventure series produced for transcription syndication. The GRH snapshot contains 54 distinct playable programs from a documented 78-program run; all frozen rows are undated, and multiple collector/Ziv numbering systems conflict.

eras.label: Ziv syndicated run
eras.notes: Pre-recorded/transcribed syndicated run starring Bogart and Bacall.

historical_context.title: Calypso musical framing
historical_context.description: King Moses, played by Jester Hairston, uses calypso-style musical bridges to comment on the action.

historical_context.title: Caribbean adventure setting
historical_context.description: The series repeatedly uses Havana, Cuba, ports, islands, ships and treasure-hunting as its adventure world.

historical_context.title: Hollywood stars in syndicated radio
historical_context.description: Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall fronted a purpose-built syndicated radio adventure series.

historical_context.title: Ziv transcription syndication
historical_context.description: Bold Venture was pre-recorded and distributed by Frederic W. Ziv Company to local stations rather than carried on one network schedule.
